Public Function Probe(ByVal path As String, ByVal which As Long, ByVal reopen As Boolean) As String
    Dim wb As Object, ws As Object, h As Object, r As Object, x As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Range("D1:D5").Value = 3
    ws.Range("D1:D5").FormatConditions.Add xlCellValue, xlGreater, "=2"
    ws.Hyperlinks.Add ws.Range("Q2"), "http://example.com/a", "", "", "L0"
    If reopen Then
        wb.SaveAs path, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        wb.Close False
        Set wb = Workbooks.Open(path)
        Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    End If
    On Error Resume Next
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        Set h = ws.Range("Q2").Hyperlinks
        If Err.Number <> 0 Then x = "hold E" & Err.Number: Err.Clear
        ws.Rows("1:2").Insert
        If Err.Number <> 0 Then x = x & "edit E" & Err.Number: Err.Clear
        x = h.Count & "/" & h.Item(1).Range.Address(False, False)
    Case 1
        Set r = ws.Range("Q2")
        If Err.Number <> 0 Then x = "hold E" & Err.Number: Err.Clear
        ws.Rows("1:2").Insert
        If Err.Number <> 0 Then x = x & "edit E" & Err.Number: Err.Clear
        x = r.Hyperlinks.Count & "/" & r.Hyperlinks(1).Range.Address(False, False)
    Case 2
        Set h = ws.Range("Q2:Q3").Hyperlinks
        If Err.Number <> 0 Then x = "hold E" & Err.Number: Err.Clear
        ws.Rows("1:2").Insert: ws.Hyperlinks.Add ws.Range("Q5"), "http://example.com/b"
        If Err.Number <> 0 Then x = x & "edit E" & Err.Number: Err.Clear
        x = h.Count & "/" & h.Item(h.Count).Range.Address(False, False)
    Case 3
        Set h = ws.Range("Q2").Hyperlinks
        If Err.Number <> 0 Then x = "hold E" & Err.Number: Err.Clear
        ws.Columns(1).Insert
        If Err.Number <> 0 Then x = x & "edit E" & Err.Number: Err.Clear
        x = h.Count & "/" & h.Item(1).Range.Address(False, False)
    Case 4
        Set h = ws.Range("D1:D5").FormatConditions
        If Err.Number <> 0 Then x = "hold E" & Err.Number: Err.Clear
        ws.Rows("1:2").Insert
        If Err.Number <> 0 Then x = x & "edit E" & Err.Number: Err.Clear
        x = h.Count & "/" & h.Item(1).Parent.Address(False, False) & "/" & h.Item(1).AppliesTo.Address(False, False)
    Case 5
        Set h = ws.Range("D3").FormatConditions(1)
        If Err.Number <> 0 Then x = "hold E" & Err.Number: Err.Clear
        ws.Rows("1:2").Insert
        If Err.Number <> 0 Then x = x & "edit E" & Err.Number: Err.Clear
        x = h.Parent.Address(False, False) & "/" & h.AppliesTo.Address(False, False)
    Case 6
        Set h = ws.Range("D3").FormatConditions(1)
        If Err.Number <> 0 Then x = "hold E" & Err.Number: Err.Clear
        ws.Rows("3").Delete
        If Err.Number <> 0 Then x = x & "edit E" & Err.Number: Err.Clear
        x = h.Parent.Address(False, False) & "/" & h.AppliesTo.Address(False, False)
    End Select
    Probe = x & "|E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    wb.Close False
End Function
